responseBody.claim: Time not spent re-diagnosing a problem the bank has already solved.
responseBody.formula: For each incident closed against a corpus match in the window: (first-occurrence MTTR for that signature) − (actual time to resolution). Summed across the window.
responseBody.method: Arithmetic over recorded timestamps. Not a model, not an estimate, and not a projection.

inputs.label: 15 reuse events this week
inputs.note: Applied and verified, not merely displayed.

inputs.label: per-signature first-occurrence MTTR
inputs.note: Drawn from two years of batch and EOD run logs.

inputs.label: actual time to resolution
inputs.note: Timestamps on the incident record itself.

responseBody.baselineRule: The baseline is the FIRST occurrence of that exact signature, not a fleet average. A signature seen only once contributes zero — there is nothing to have saved against.

excludes.what: Incidents resolved without a corpus match
excludes.why: There is no first-occurrence baseline to compare them against, so they contribute nothing rather than an assumed value.
Their first occurrence falls inside the run-log gap on the DR node, so no baseline exists for them. They are excluded entirely rather than back-filled from a neighbouring signature.

excludes.what: Work done by people outside NehishLens
excludes.why: NehishLens records evidence, approval and verification; it does not observe what happens in the bank’s own tooling, so it does not claim time saved there.

responseBody.confirmed: Reconciled against the incident record at 04:02. Every term in the sum traces to a timestamped row.
